scope: Fact audit of the historical Post-U8 / D15 evidence sets against the VERSION_PLAN 0.9.0 and 0.9.x completion gates. Every status is derived from the latest committed business evidence, not from historical document PASS labels or CI colors. Statuses are read at the frozen base commit below.

base.origin_main_subject: feat(data): P100-B Tushare index_dailybasic contract, storage, incremental sync and readiness (#337)

status_definitions.covered: The latest committed business evidence on the base commit satisfies the item as scoped.
status_definitions.superseded: The item was intentionally ended/redirected and replaced by a later named boundary; it is not a pass.
status_definitions.open: A latest conclusion exists but is not current on the base commit, or a named closure slice is still missing.
status_definitions.blocked: A required external input or prerequisite is unavailable; no substitute may be fabricated.

version_plan_gates.deliverable: 为现有 Beta 建立统一产品版本和已知限制基线
version_plan_gates.gate: 发布清单绑定源码、镜像和实际服务组合，完成独立发布验收
version_plan_gates.reason: The historical v0.9.0-beta Git tag is a pre-release marker only; no formal byq-release.v1 manifest binding source SHA, all-service digests, actual composition, migration, backup, rollback and independent acceptance exists on the base commit.

version_plan_gates.deliverable: 完整 F2、剩余全接口审计、复合研究故障回归
version_plan_gates.gate: Post-U8 各项有最新结论；不把 F6 完成或健康检查等同整体关闭
version_plan_gates.reason: The interface-level reconciliation ledger is not current on the base commit (complete=false), the composite research fault regression has no committed execution evidence, and D15 retains four atomic blockers. Named child slices are covered where cited.

items.title: 持久的未知结果核对（write unknown-result reconciliation）
items.reason: The named F2 child slices are covered, but there is no current on-base-commit closure of complete F2. The H4 whole-interface ledger that carried the completion claim now reports complete=false on the base commit.
items.latest_conclusion: Named F2 slices verified at their own commits; the whole-F2 completion claim is stale on the base commit.

covered_slices.note: Three MCP research creation families: durable original-request receipt watch, real PostgreSQL restart probe, 30/30 immutable qualification and real Product API desktop/mobile journeys.
F2-PUB-01 local verified: bounded page scan replaces first-page-only republish. Synthetic failure-path evidence only; not a production duplicate-Issue finding.

items.title: 历史指数成分准备与准确说明
items.reason: The real read-only historical constituent source (Community cache/connection) is unavailable, so historical coverage and the full time series cannot be proven. Single-time-point preparation is implemented but not equivalent to a historical series.
items.latest_conclusion: Isolated implementation slices pass with synthetic data; real history remains blocked by missing read-only source and by the absence of a complete change-over-time series.
items.does_not_prove: Any claim that five-year-ago constituents are available, or that a single static snapshot is a historical constituent series.
items.blocker: No authenticated/validated read-only Community historical constituent export or connection.

items.title: 剩余全接口审计（H4 逐接口台账）
items.reason: At its own commit the H4 ledger reported reviewed=560, verified=560, complete=true. On the base commit scripts/ci/check-reliability-review.py reports complete=false with unreviewed=6 and many source-drift errors across Backend/Gateway/MCP/Worker entries, so the audit is not current.
items.latest_conclusion: Interface ledger complete only at its historical commit; source drift makes it non-current on the base commit.

observed_on_base_commit.note: The tool exits 0 without --require-complete; it is a read-only reporter, not a CI pass. The drift is the evidence that the ledger must be re-baselined before it can support a 0.9.x closure claim.

items.title: 复合研究故障回归（改进策略 → 审批 → 训练 → 预测 → 回测 → 新旧比较，含故障注入）
items.reason: H5 executed a real three-round backtest and report selection on an isolated stack, but the full composite journey and the R1-R5 fault matrix (disconnect/timeout/cancel/worker-kill/service-restart/late-result) have no committed execution evidence.
items.latest_conclusion: End-to-end three-round research is covered; the composite fault regression is not.

covered_portion.note: Real paid model, isolated stack, three same-task backtests (+3.35%/+1.26%/0%), validated report, selected best, bound paper account; verify_completion passed on real persisted objects.

missing: Composite improve-strategy → approval → training → prediction → backtest → comparison journey under injected faults.
The R1-R5 deterministic fault matrix (60/180/600/900 clocks, cancel/timeout/late-result at-most-once, stale-active closure).

items.title: 研究流程连续性整改 H1–H5
items.reason: H1-H3 and H5 have committed business evidence on the base commit; H5 completed the real three-round research. The H4 interface-ledger sub-item is tracked separately above as full-interface-audit and is open on the base commit.
items.latest_conclusion: H1–H5 completed; H4 ledger currency is tracked under full-interface-audit.
items.note: H1–H5 merged via PR #280; H5 build revision dsh-0.1.2rc1-post-u8.115.

items.title: DSH 0.1.2rc1 U8 生产观察与稳定性验收
items.reason: U8 was explicitly CLOSED_EARLY_REMEDIATION_REQUIRED by maintainer decision. The 24-hour gate was waived, not passed (78 samples / 4h25m), and semantic acceptance failed. It was replaced by the ADR-0062 Post-U8 reliability boundaries and the R/S/F remediation program.
items.latest_conclusion: U8 is not a stability PASS; it is a documented early close whose failures seeded the Post-U8 remediation.
items.superseded_by: ADR-0062 + Post-U8 R1–R5 / S1–S3 / F1–F10 remediation

items.title: DSH 0.1.5-rc.1 原生连续性资格（Runtime Continuity D15）
items.reason: D15-G is an honest NO_GO derived by a fail-able observer: four atomic required capabilities are BLOCKED. D15-2/D15-3/D15-3R/D15-4 partial and D15-5 partial are PASS where stated.
items.latest_conclusion: D15-G NO_GO (NOT-PASS); R3_RESUME=NO; production selector dsh-0.1.2rc1 unchanged.
